ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
The DataModelDict class is used for handling data models that have
equivalent representations in XML, JSON, and Python. Constructing
data models in this way is convenient as it supports compatibility
across different software tools, such as different types of databases.
about.summary: Provides the Python DataModelDict class for creating, accessing and manipulating JSON/XML data structures.

name: datamodeldict
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "datamodeldict" %}
{% set version = "0.9.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/D/DataModelDict/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d6404f4682daba7a4fb07ab670a8ef277afd8fd4926345c91d5986719dbd04e7

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 1
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - uv-build
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - xmltodict

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - DataModelDict
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://github.com/usnistgov/DataModelDict
  license: NIST-Software
  license_file: LICENSE.TXT
  summary: Provides the Python DataModelDict class for creating, accessing and manipulating JSON/XML data structures.

  description: |
    The DataModelDict class is used for handling data models that have 
    equivalent representations in XML, JSON, and Python. Constructing 
    data models in this way is convenient as it supports compatibility 
    across different software tools, such as different types of databases.
  doc_url: https://github.com/usnistgov/DataModelDict
  dev_url: https://github.com/usnistgov/DataModelDict

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - lmhale99
